name: spurious_payload-environment
description: Runtime manifest for the book a filtered fare and confirm workflow.

tools.search: Searches available fares and records searched.
tools.filter_fares: Requires searched fares, keeps fares below 500, records filtered, and records price below 500.
tools.book: Requires filtered fares, books the selected fare, and records booked.
tools.email: Requires a booked fare, sends the customer confirmation email, and records confirmation_sent.
